_about: Age x ethnicity/nationality figures for the age selector (schema harm-data/age-bands/v1). Built from official sources; values are never imputed or pro-rated. Category labels are kept as published.

fit_codes.exact: published band(s) add up exactly to the standard band
fit_codes.derived_exact: obtained exactly by adding/subtracting published cells (no assumptions)
fit_codes.computed_microdata: our tabulation of an official record-level file, exact ages
fit_codes.estimated: only an overlapping published band exists; the value shown is for approx_band, never pro-rated
fit_codes.unavailable: no published or computable figure for this band

race_notes: Australia publishes crime statistics by Indigenous status (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander / Non-Indigenous), not by ancestry or ethnic origin. Labels are as published by ABS.

Victims by age are published only for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander victims in NSW, Qld and SA (NT np), so within an age band the comparison is between states, not between Indigenous and non-Indigenous people.
Offenders by Indigenous status are published by offence for all ages combined; by age only for all offences combined.

series.title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander homicide victims by state, 2025 (all ages)
series.descriptor: Police-recorded homicide victims (murder, attempted murder, manslaughter) who are Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander (ABS Table 23)
series.race_basis: Indigenous status as recorded by police (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander victims only)
series.rate_unit: per 100,000 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander persons in the state (ABS-published)
notes: ABS does not publish homicide victims by age and Indigenous status. Includes attempted murder; excludes driving causing death.
Queensland 2024 and 2025: np; Northern Territory from 2023: np.

AIC National Homicide Monitoring Program (Homicide in Australia 2023–24, Table 18) publishes Indigenous homicide victims by age, but aic.gov.au timed out from our machine on 2026-11-20 and was not used.

series.title: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander victims of sexual assault, by age at report and state, 2025
series.descriptor: Police-recorded sexual assault victims who are Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander (ABS Recorded Crime – Victims, Table 26), age at report
series.race_basis: Indigenous status as recorded by police (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander victims only)
series.coverage: New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia, Northern Territory (only states for which ABS publishes Indigenous status of victims); Northern Territory not published from 2023
series.rate_unit: per 100,000 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander persons in the state/territory and age group (ABS-published; given only where one published band or published aggregate matches)

0-17.note: ABS-published aggregate used as published (perturbed components may not sum to it)

series.native_note: ABS bands by age at report: 0–9, 10–17, 18–24, 25–34, 35–44, 45–54, 55–64, 65 years and over, plus published aggregates Under 18 / 18 years and over. Values are ABS-perturbed (cells randomly adjusted; components may not sum to totals). np = not published.
notes: Sexual assault as recorded by police (ANZSOC 031); age at report to police.
Non-Indigenous victims are not published by age in this release, so no comparison group is available within age bands; groups here are states, not ethnic groups.
Northern Territory: np (Indigenous status not published from 2023).
All-ages total includes victims whose age was not specified.

notes: Sexual assault as recorded by police (ANZSOC 031); age at incident. Many child victims report years later, so age at incident shifts counts towards childhood.
